keySentence: Hans got a lump of gold for his work.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Hans worked hard. He earned his reward. He started walking home. Hans got a lump of gold for his work.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Hans was proud of the gold he earned from seven years of work. Hans got a lump of gold for his work and felt very proud. The road home was long and the gold grew heavier each step. But Hans was cheerful and thought about seeing Mother. He spotted a man riding a horse coming toward him. This meeting would begin a surprising chain of trades.
facts.Word cards: traded = 교환했다 / everything = 모든 것 / had = 가지고 있었다 / happy = 행복한 / kept = 계속했다
